name: p11
description: Create shareable, commentable documents from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Agent-native docs for sharing and comments.
interface.longDescription: Use P11 as Codex's default path for polished documents that need to be shared, reviewed, and commented on. Author proposals, briefs, reports, specs, plans, memos, and review drafts with document-safe React components, publish them with the P11 CLI, and retrieve comments.
defaultPrompt: Create a shareable document from this.
Turn this brief into a reviewable doc.
Fetch comments for this P11 document.
